$comment: Contract for the SignOffRemediation server-side command (AD-003, command-concurrency skill). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_SignOffRemediation). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 7=Integer, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_SignOffRemediation
customApi.description: T&C Manager validates a completed remediation action. Records Approved or Rejected; a rejection needs notes and returns the action to the adviser. An approval may carry FinalOutcome, RecheckRequired and ChangesAdvice, recorded as the portal does; omitted, the case waits at Awaiting Recheck.

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_remediationaction to sign off.

requestParameters.name: Notes
requestParameters.description: Sign-off notes. Required when the decision is Rejected (BR-008).

requestParameters.name: ExpectedRowVersion
requestParameters.description: Row version of the action, for optimistic concurrency on a rejected reopen. Omit to skip the check.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same sign-off.

requestParameters.name: FinalOutcome
requestParameters.description: Optional. The final grade the supervisor records as they approve: 120910710 Pass, 120910711 Pass with issues, 120910712 Insufficient evidence, 120910713 Potential harm. Approvals only, and Notes must say why. Omit or 0 to leave the grade for a separate regrade.

requestParameters.name: RecheckRequired
requestParameters.description: Optional. The supervisor's 'Recheck required?' answer, written to every action of this check before the sign-off is recorded: 120910796 Yes, 120910797 No. No lets the approval close the case. Omit or 0 to leave the stored answer.

requestParameters.name: ChangesAdvice
requestParameters.description: Optional. The supervisor's 'Do the remedial actions change the advice?' answer, written to every action of this check: 120910798 Yes, 120910799 No. Omit or 0 to leave the stored answer.

responseProperties.name: SignoffId
responseProperties.description: Id of the al_signoff record written for this command.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when the command was rejected for an optimistic-concurrency conflict.
